question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Grudje'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** incorrect word** among the given options is** "Grudje."**
 
• The **correct spelling **of this word is "Grudge".
 
• "Grudge" means to be resentfully unwilling to give or allow something
 
 
• **Example**: I don't **grudge** the time I spend on it.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Grudje'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Flown:** The past participle of "fly," which means to move through the air under control.(उड़ा (उड़ना के अतीतकाल का रूप))
 
• **Adhere:** To stick fast to a substance or surface, or to believe in and follow the practices of.(चिपकना या अनुसरण करना)
